artworks.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.artist: Jan Muller
artworks.description: The image portrays a woman holding an infant in her arms. She is sitting outdoors, surrounded by a tree on the left and a rocky formation on the right. The background shows a serene landscape with gentle slopes, shrubs, and greenery. Latin text is inscribed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Venus and Mercury
artworks.artist: Jan Muller, after Bartholomaeus Spranger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures in a complex composition. The artwork illustrates a dynamic scene featuring classical figures, including winged cherubs, drapery, and other mythological elements. The central composition is marked by strong diagonal lines created by the figures' limbs and flowing fabric. The figures are depicted with detailed musculature and an emphasis on movement, captured in intricate lines and shading typical of engravings. The cherubs are depicted with playful expressions, holding attributes like a staff and wings. Overall, the drawing exhibits a sense of drama and baroque intricacy.

artworks.title: Hercules and Antaeus
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Possenti
artworks.medium: etching with plate tone on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing intertwined forms. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses with flowing fabric. One central figure lifts another in a powerful pose. The lines are drawn with a strong, lively style, capturing movement and strength. The background is minimal, with emphasis on light and shadow to highlight the figures' anatomy. The composition suggests struggle and drama, with deep lines creating depth and intensity in a classical theme.

artworks.title: La Befana
artworks.artist: Bartolomeo Pinelli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a market scene. There is a central display of goods, possibly food items like cakes or sweets, arranged in a pyramid fashion. A figure above the stall is dressed in elaborate clothing, crowned, and holding a staff. Below, there are many people, mostly children and women, interacting with the goods. The environment is decorated with garlands, and a window shows the interior of a building. The drawing captures a lively and engaging atmosphere of a festive market.

artworks.title: The Star of the Kings: A Night Piece
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: This image features a dark scene with intricate cross-hatching and line work. A glowing star illuminates the center right, casting light on part of the surroundings. The rest of the image is filled with textured shading suggesting figures and a setting that fades into shadows, creating a mysterious and deep atmosphere.

artworks.title: Hercules and Omphale
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II, after Bartholomaeus Spranger
artworks.description: The image shows various figures in a detailed setting. In the foreground, a man with curly hair and a draped cloth over his lower body holds a distaff with wool. Across from him, a woman with long hair sits on a chair with a lion's mask on her face. Another woman in a dress with puffy sleeves emerges from behind a curtain on the left, with a cherub-like figure above her. An elderly woman is seated on the right, holding an object. A basket of fruit is on the table next to the man. The background features curtains, columns, and other architectural elements.

artworks.title: Air
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Dirck Barendsz
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.5 × 23.1 cm (6 7/8 × 9 1/8 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: The image displays a person reclined amidst swirling clouds, their body slightly angled with the left arm resting on a cloud and the right arm extended outwards. The person has a serene gaze directed upwards, with short, curly hair adorned with a thin band or headpiece. They wear flowing drapery covering the legs and wrapped around the upper torso, leaving the shoulders exposed. A small peacock is positioned to the right side, showing its feathers. The background is filled with clouds.

artworks.title: Wisdom Conquering Ignorance
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II, after Bartholomaeus Spranger
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 50.8 x 35.9 cm (20 x 14 1/8 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving with several figures. In the center is a muscular, armored figure holding a sword, standing over a large man lying on his stomach. The armored figure wears a decorated helmet and long hair. A nude, winged cherub hovers above, holding a laurel wreath. Other semi-clad figures surround them, some holding objects. At the base, a seated woman wears a laurel wreath and reads from a book. The scene is set against a textured, dark background emphasizing light and shadow on the figures.

artworks.title: Bartholomaeus Spranger and his Late Wife Christina Muller
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II, after Bartholomaeus Spranger
artworks.description: The image portrays a detailed allegorical scene with multiple figures and intricate elements. In the center left, a man is depicted from the waist up, wearing a richly adorned garment with a high ruffled collar. His facial hair is styled in a moustache and pointed beard, and he has a serious expression. Behind him, angelic figures and allegorical beings hold various objects like trumpets and a scythe. On the right, an ornate oval portrait of a woman is shown from the chest up, adorned with a lace collar and neatly styled hair. She has a solemn and composed expression. Below the portrait, a cherub holds up a drapery that reveals a skull. Around the figures are items related to art and time, such as a painter's palette, an hourglass, and bones. The background is filled with elaborate ornamentation, including fruits and decorative elements, creating a rich visual environment.

artworks.title: Bartholomaeus Spranger and his Late Wife Christina Muller
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II, after Bartholomaeus Spranger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene featuring numerous symbolic figures and objects. The drawing is detailed and elaborate, with mythical and allegorical figures surrounding a framed portrait of a young woman. The young woman is elegantly dressed, and her portrait is held within an ornate frame adorned with foliage and symbolic motifs. Surrounding her are figures such as winged angels, a skeletal figure holding an hourglass and a scythe, and other characters associated with themes of time, mortality, and artistic endeavor. One figure appears to be an artist holding a palette and brushes, gazing out from the lower left. Above, a banner is held aloft by cherubs. The image is rich in symbolism, suggesting themes of time, impermanence, art, and knowledge in the style of the Northern Renaissance.

artworks.title: Annunciation to the Shepherds
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Abraham Bloemaert
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 55.7 x 40.1 cm (21 15/16 x 15 13/16 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with celestial figures. The image depicts a tranquil rural setting where animals, including a cow and a sheep, are present amidst a small community. Above, there are cherubs and celestial beings in the clouds. The composition includes details such as rustic structures and forested landscapes. The line work and shading create depth, highlighting the interactions between the earthly and heavenly realms.

artworks.title: Artist Painting a Nude Woman: Allegory of Visual Perception
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various allegorical figures engaged in artistic and scientific pursuits. The composition includes a winged cherub-like figure holding an artist's palette and compass, a seated nude figure, and various objects such as a globe, geometrical shapes, and a cat. In the background, there is a ship sailing on water and a bird soaring in the sky. The scene is rendered with intricate line work.

artworks.title: Morning
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a family scene with three adults and two children. In the center, a seated woman wears a long dress with a ruffled collar, holding a piece of fabric and a needle. To her right, an older man and another adult or young man with shoulder-length hair are seated at a table looking at a book, with a quill and inkpot on the table. The two children stand in front of the woman, one holding a book, the other with a bag. They all wear period clothing with ruffled collars and voluminous sleeves. A small dog stands near the children. In the background, there are two framed images on the wall, a shelf with jars and abstract shapes, and a basket on the floor. The setting has a historical aesthetic capturing a moment of family interaction and engagement.

artworks.title: Midday
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 21.1 x 15 cm (8 5/16 x 5 7/8 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of four people engaged in various activities. Most of their bodies are shown, focusing primarily on their upper bodies and arms. On the left, a man is bending slightly forward, holding a saw over a bench. He has curly hair and wears a long-sleeved garment with decorative buttons. Next to him, another man is seated, working with a chisel and plane on a piece of wood. This man wears a hat, and his hair appears to be short and curly. In the center-right, a woman is seated, looking to her right where another woman is slightly leaning towards her. The seated woman has styled hair pulled back, and she wears a dress with a ruffled collar and puffed sleeves. Her hands rest on a musical instrument. The woman at her side has similarly styled hair and wears a simpler dress with a shawl. Around them are various woodworking tools and planks of wood. The background features a large building with multiple stories and a pastoral scene with a figure tending to animals under an open sky with clouds. The upper portion of the image shows a figure among the clouds, depicted as resting and holding a horn.

artworks.title: Allegory of Flourishing State of the United Provinces
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 42.8 × 55.5 cm (16 7/8 × 21 7/8 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a complex narrative scene featuring a variety of animals, figures, and mythical creatures within a forest landscape. Trees frame the scene and a procession of horses is depicted in the center, led by elaborately dressed figures. Other figures and animals are scattered throughout the composition, with a person playing a musical instrument on the left side. The drawing combines elements of reality and fantasy, creating a richly patterned and dynamic atmosphere suggesting a significant story with symbolic undertones.

artworks.title: Neptune and Amphitrite
artworks.artist: Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows two figures seated on a rock surrounded by water. The figure on the left appears youthful, with smooth features and short, wavy hair. Their body is partially covered by draped cloth. The figure on the right is more mature, with a strong build, a long beard, and curly hair. They hold a trident. Both figures have classical features. Large fish swim around them in the water. The background includes a calm body of water with a distant cityscape under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Prophet Elijah with the Widow of Zarephath
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Abraham Bloemaert
artworks.description: The image depicts an outdoor scene with ruins and figures engaged in an interaction. The scene is set before a rustic, crumbling structure with arches and exposed brickwork. In the background, more ancient architecture can be seen, such as domes and additional structures partially obscured by the ruin in the foreground. There is a fenced area in the foreground with a figure on a ladder. The central action includes two figures; one is seated on the ground, reaching towards another figure standing with a long stick or staff. Their interaction seems dynamic, with the standing figure leaning over with an arm extended. The drawing displays depth and texture through fine lines and shading, highlighting detail in the brickwork, clothes, and foliage in the scene.

artworks.title: Salome Dancing Before Herod
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Karel van Mander I
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 26.7 x 40.9 cm (10 1/2 x 16 1/8 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: This drawing features a court scene with elaborately dressed figures in an opulent interior setting. In the foreground, two figures in ornate clothing are holding a significant object. To the left, a panel of authorities with unique attire is seated at a table. The backdrop includes a rich, patterned curtain. To the right and in the background, there is a window and a smaller scene with multiple figures. The composition conveys a mix of formal grandeur and intrigue.

artworks.title: Samarian Woman at the Well
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.6 x 13.7 cm (7 5/16 x 5 3/8 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a woman who is seated, slightly turned to the side with her head tilted upwards, gazing upward to the left. Her facial features include large eyes, a straight nose, and delicate lips. She has wavy hair that is mostly covered by a large turban or headwrap. The woman is wearing an elaborate dress with full sleeves and a draped, textured look. She has a necklace of round beads and a bracelet around her wrist. One hand supports a large, ornate jug that is decorated with a face and intricate patterns. The background illustrates a natural landscape with rolling hills and a tree on the left side, with some figures and animals visible in the distance on the right. The setting has a softened, etched quality, typical of historical artwork.

artworks.title: Vanitas, Vanitatum et Omnia Vanitas
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Abraham Bloemaert
artworks.description: The image features a woman seated in a reclined position from head to knees. She gazes to the right with delicate facial features, curly hair partly covered by flowing headgear or fabric with wing-like elements. She wears a draped garment exposing her shoulders and upper chest, and is interacted with objects on a table: a rod, smoking container, ornate vessels, and a candle-like object. Swirling clouds or smoke form the background, and the scene is encircled by a decorative calligraphic border.

artworks.title: Sine Cerere et Baccho Friget Venus
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Abraham Bloemaert
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 27 x 20.2 cm (10 5/8 x 7 15/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene featuring classical symbols of abundance. The scene depicts three figures surrounded by a lush array of fruits, including grapes and pomegranates. The attire and attributes, such as grape leaves adorning the central figure, hint at associations with Ceres and Bacchus, deities of agriculture and wine. The central figure holds a sickle, an agricultural tool, emphasizing the theme of harvest and fertility. The detailing of clothing, flora, and facial expressions suggests a style reminiscent of classical or Renaissance-era art. Latin text beneath the image conveys a connection to mythological or literary themes, enhancing the allegorical nature of the scene.

artworks.title: The Cult of Ceres
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in an outdoor setting, surrounded by three men. The woman has braided hair adorned with plant stalks, and is holding a basket and a sickle. The men are kneeling or crouching, dressed in simple clothing and holding farming tools. The background features fields, workers, and mountains under a cloudy sky with a bright sun.

artworks.title: The Cult of Venus
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a woman on the left holding a flaming heart, with a winged cherub next to her. On the right, a man kneels next to a woman who is holding a flower. Other figures are partially visible in the background. The setting includes a landscape and a chariot pulled by two horses in the sky. The scene is engraved with fine lines and detailed.

artworks.title: The Cult of Bacchus
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group featuring a central allegorical figure. The scene depicts a classical theme with a central nude figure adorned with drapery and an elaborate headpiece of grapevines and leaves, suggestive of a mythical or god-like entity possibly related to wine or harvest, holding grapes. Around are other figures, likely peasants or followers, appearing to admire or supplicate the central figure. The setting suggests a pastoral landscape with rolling hills and distant structures. The figures are portrayed in intricate detail, highlighting exaggerated expressions and dynamic poses typical of the Baroque style. The composition suggests a narrative moment, with attention to the interplay between the figures and the background landscape.
